describes: An invented shop's checkout, reached purely through path-shape + label-lexicon + instalment-phrase signals (no adapter host match involved at all): a labelled 'Order total' row and a bound count+money+cadence phrase both hard-gate, and a radiogroup payment method picker rounds out detectCheckout's 2-of-3. The generic path's own signal ceiling (labelled_total_row + bound_cluster, 2 of 6 possible here -- no provider widget in this fixture) sits below SOFT_SCORE_CONFIRMABLE_FLOOR (4), so this reaches PARTIAL with every scalar present, never PARSED_CONFIRMABLE. That PARTIAL result is what routes the overlay straight to the pre-filled manual-entry sheet (src/overlay/OverlayHost.ts's renderManual) -- detect, extract, the user confirms, calendar -- with no host match and no elevated port needed.
